name: Folsom Winter 2023
information: Get ready for Folsom's first cubing competition! ### **Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.** **Competition Day Timing** - The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. - Lunch will end at the scheduled time. - Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.
